tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos gtam thar par 'khrid pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba/ 'chi kha bar do'i 'gro ba rnams la gdams pa bzhugs so// dpal stug dbang po kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// dpyad gsum dag pas 'gro ba bde nas bder 'dren pa// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i pha rol dpag yas e waṃ pa// kun bzang yab sras brgyud par bcas rnams gtsug tu mchod// 'da' kar phan pa rjes su gdams pas ches dbul ba'i// dge spyod bde ba'i go sar mngon par 'dod blo can// sug pa'i yal ga zlum pos brag ri brtsegs pa'i logs// nyer 'khyud mngon 'dod rtse mor phyin 'dod rjes su snyegs// dal 'byor 'tsho ba'i bsil sbyin dkyil 'khor snga lam du// bgrod nye dus kyi sgra gcan mun stug gis 'khyud tshe// gsal 'debs ches zab gdams pa'i lam sgron 'degs pa'i tshul// yid ches gzhung don yi ges 'chad la gnang ba stsol// de'ang su zhig nges par 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i dus kyis gtugs pa na/ phan pa'i gdams pa gsal 'debs bya ba'i tshul go bde bar tshigs su bcad pa'i ngag gis gdams par 'dod pas snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas 'di skad brjod de/ kye ho che ge mo zhes bya ba khyod// bdag la tshur gson rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs// skyes bu'i tshe srog nam mkha'i glog 'gyu dang*// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro// zhes gsungs phyir na mngon par 'dus byas pa'i// chos can thams cad mi rtag brtan pa med// khyad par da ltar khyod kyi tshe dang las// bsod nams 'phen pa gsum ga zad pa la// cis kyang ma bzlog 'chi ba'i dus la bab// de tshe 'od gsal 'pho ba bar do gsum// gang rung gdams pa khyod la bshad kyis nyon// dang por 'chi ba 'od gsal zhes bya ba// de ni gnyis med rnam par rgyal ba las// lus can rnams ni nges par 'chi ba'i tshe// sa ni chur thim chu ni me la thim// me ni rlung la rlung ni rnam shes thim// rnam shes bzung ba 'od gsal 'jug par 'gyur// zhes gsungs don ni 'gro ba ma lus pa// skye ba na yang 'byung bzhi'i rim pas skye// gnas pa na yang 'byung bzhi snyoms pas gnas// 'chi ba 'byung bzhi 'jig pas 'chi ba ste// sa ni chur thim dbang po'i sgo rnams gsher// lus kyis bsgul bskyod mi nus shin tu lci// mgo bo mi theg lag pas gos sogs nam// mig gnyis khong du rdib cing mi gsal 'gro// nang du smig rgyu lta bu'i snang ba 'char// chu ni me la thim rtags kha sna skam// mchu byer so ni rtseg cing dreg pa chags// sna zhom dri mi tshor la rna ba 'on// nang du du ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char// me ni rlung la thim pas skyigs bu 'byung*// lus kyi drod sdud gdong gi bkram mdangs yal// lce thung ro bcud mi tshor gtam mi gsal// nang du me khyer lta bu'i snang ba 'char// rlung ni rnam shes la thim mig gyen ldog

/dbugs ni phyir rgyu ring zhing sdud pa thung*// lus kyis reg bya mi shes bshang gci 'chor// mar me 'bar ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char// dam pa dang po'i rgyud las 'di skad du// lus can rnams ni 'chi ba de yi tshe// bdud rtsi zla ba thur du 'bab pa dang*// zla mtshan nyi ma yang ni gyen du ldog /rnam shes srid pa'i mtshan nyid can gsungs pa// dbu ma'i yas sner pha las thob pa'i khams// dkar cha rkyang mas bzung ba thur du bab// stong pa dkar lam zla ba shar 'dra 'byung*// 'dod chags las gyur rnam rtog so gsum 'gag /ma las thob pa'i dmar cha dbu ma'i snar// ro ma'i nus pas bzung ba gyen du ldog /stong chen dmar lam nyi ma shar 'dra 'byung*// zhe sdang las gyur rnam rtog bzhi bcu 'gag /thig le dkar dmar snying gar phrad pa las// shin tu stong pa nag lam mun pa 'thibs// gti mug las gyur rnam rtog bdun po 'gag /de mthar thams cad stong pa zhes bya ba// rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim nas// spros bral stong gsal mchog gi ting 'dzin skye// 'di ni sems can kun la 'byung srid kyang*// phal cher goms 'dris med pas mun par 'thums// lam dus goms pa'i myong ba 'od gsal dang*// gzhi la gnas pa'i 'od gsal 'dres pa la// 'od gsal ma bu mjal ba zhes bya ste// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku shar ba na// sngar 'dris mdza' bo phrad ltar shes pas ni// zung 'jug blo 'das bskyangs pas don chen 'grub// de la de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba'am// 'chi ba chos skur 'tshang rgya zhes bya'o// ji skad bshad pa'i gnas skabs de dang der// 'khrul snang bden par ma zhen cir snang dngos// spros bral sgyu ma'i rol rtsed gtan phab nas// gnas lugs skye 'gag gnas pa bral ba'i ngang*// stong nyid 'od gsal zung 'jug rang zhal ltos// snang gsang sngags pa yin na/ grag rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi// rol par nyams su blangs pas don chen 'grub// de nas 'pho ba la/

thog mar dbang khrid ma thob pa'i 'gro phal spyi dang khyad par bzang spyod smon lam gyi dge sbyor lhur len pa'i rigs la bya ba ni/ gnyis pa 'da' ka 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni/ skabs 'dir rlung ni rnam shes thim pa tshun// 'chi kha'i gdams pa bshad la sems gtod mdzod// phal chen kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang*// dkon mchog brtsegs pa las gsungs 'chi kha ma'i// ngo mtshar gdams pa 'jam dpal dze tā ri// sa skya'i bla chen las brgyud bshad kyis nyon// su zhig nyams su blangs pas da lta'i lus// sbrul gyi shun pa ltar bskyur bde ba can// padmar brdzus skyes snang ba mtha' yas las// dam chos thob 'gyur mi bslu nges pa'i don// 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las// dang por skyabs 'gro ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum// sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs ltar bzhugs pa la// 'jigs pa kun las skyob pa'i skyabs kyi mchog /gtan du bzung snyam rjes zlos 'di ltar gyis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// dpal ldan bla ma ston mchog rdzogs sangs rgyas// dam chos 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la// deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro// zhes lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ 'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las bsgral phyir// bdag gi rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bya// de yi ched du bde chen bgrod pa'i lam// snang ba mtha' yas ting 'dzin bsgom par bya// zhes lan gsum/ khyed rang gnas pa'i sa 'di dag pa'i zhing*// bde ba can gyi bkod pa phun tshogs bsam// rang nyid thugs rje che sogs lhar gsal ba'i// nam mkhar ye shes rang snang rin chen khri/ padma zla ba brtsegs pa'i gdan stengs su// rgyal ba snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig 'dzum zhal phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag steng*// lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa'i sku// dar gyi na sa paṇa gyis 'di ltar mdzad la/

'phags pa rin po ches rgyan cha mi gsal bas chos gos gsum pa sogs gang mos mdzad pa'i dgongs pa yin nam snyam/ bza' rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs par sgoms// de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas bskor bar gyur// de la bdun rnam dag bya ba rgyas par na/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i ji snyed su dag nas/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar brjod/ mi nus na/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i chos spyod bcu pa ni/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs// lus can kun dang thabs cig tu// mkha' mnyam bzhugs la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// de dag kun la kun nas mchod// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// de yi spyod pa'ang bdag gis spyad// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa'am/ yang na kho bos 'phags pa rin po ches tshig lhug par gsungs pa'i don tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa 'di 'don pa la mos na/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// bdag lus grangs med btud pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// me tog bdug pa mar me dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo mchod pa kun gyis mchod// dkon mchog gsum dang 'od dpag med mgon la// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro// tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig ltung bshags shing bsdam// 'phags bzhi so skye'i dge la rjes yi rang*// smra mchog kun la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge bas 'od dpag med pa'i drung skyes nas// rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro don byed par shog

/ces pa de gsum gang rung re brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de nas sdig pa dag snyam nges shes bskyed// tshe 'di'i yul la chags zhen thams cad spongs// 'chi la mi 'jigs bde ba can gyi zhing*// nges par 'gro snyam gsol ba 'di ltar thob// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas khyed kyi zhing*// myur skye byang chub lung bstan thob par mdzod// ces pa dad gus drag pos gsol btab mthar/ khyed rang rnam shes 'od zer dkar po'i gzugs// sna sgo'i rlung dang mnyam du phyir thon nas// rgyal ba'i shangs bug nas zhugs thugs kar thim// rang sems rgyal ba'i thugs dang dbyer med bsres// rlung nang 'jug dus rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas// 'od byung khyod kyi khar zhugs snying gar thim// rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang sems 'dres par bsam// de 'dra dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong ci nus sgoms// gsum pa rjes ni/ mtha' skor bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras// phyi nas rim zhu 'od dpag med la thim// de yang 'od zhu rang la rang nyid kyang*// 'od zhu bla ma sangs rgyas rang sems gsum// dbyer med 'khor 'das ro gcig ngang du zhog /slar yang rang nyid 'od dpag med skur ldang*// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// padma dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /ces dang*/ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang sems can kun// nying mtshams sbyar ma thag tu bde ldan zhing*// brdzus te skyes nas 'od dpag med mgon las// zab rgyas dam chos thos pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// zhes brjod cing*/ rnam pa thams cad du rang gang du gnas kyang bde ba can gyi zhing yin snyam pa dang*/ rang nyid bde chen zhing gi mgon po 'od dpag med yin snyam pa las/ 'khrul snang gi dbang du ma song na don chen 'grub par 'gyur ro// de las gzhan pa'i gang zag thugs rje chen po'i yi ge drug pa'i bzlas bsgom lhur len pa'i 'gro ba dbang dang gdams ngag thob pa sogs spyi la bya ba ni/

kye ho che ge mo zhes bya ba khyod ces pa nas/ 'chi rim ngo sprod gong ltar brjod pa'i rjes sam ma brjod kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang 'di skad brjod de/ skabs 'dir rlung ni rnam shes thim pa tshun// 'pho ba'i gdams pa bshad la sems gtod mdzod// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung 'chi med bcud// bsgom pa'i snyim pas legs bzhes yon tan lus// kho lag rdzogs pa'i grub chen tshem bu pa// gang las brgyud pa'i thugs rje chen po yi// smar khrid lugs kyi myur lam rnal 'byor brten// rnam par shes pa spyi gtsug gser sgo nas// bde lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa bshad kyis nyon// sdug bsngal 'byung gnas tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la// nags tshal tshig pa'i bya bzhin ma chags mdzod// 'da' ka ma yi rnal 'byor gnad song na// sangs rgyas zhing ngam mkha' spyod rig 'dzin skye// de ni lus dngos lhag pa lha yi gzugs// tshe ni nyi zla gnas kyi bar 'tsho ba// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku las chos mnyan cing*// longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod las 'byung bar bshad// sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum// zhes sogs nas/ deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro// zhes dang*/ sems bskyed ni/ 'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las bsgral phyir// bdag gi rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bya// de yi ched du gang zag 'bring gi lam// 'chi kha'i 'pho ba nyams su blang bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum dang*/ skyabs yul spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa sogs// yan lag bdun pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa lan gsum brjod pas rgyud dag byas/ dngos gzhi'i don du dmigs pa 'di ltar gyis// chos kun rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las// khyed rang yi dam thugs rje chen po'i sku// dkar gsal snang stong 'ja' lus lta bur bsgoms// rang gi lte ba'i 'og nas spyi gtsug bar// dbu ma 'od kyi sbu gu mda' smyug tsam// shel gyi ka ba btsugs ltar yod par bsams// de yi mas snar chos 'byung sngon po'i steng*// rnam shes ngo bo thig le ser rdog tsam// dkar sngo dmar 'od 'phro ba'i rnam par bsam// snying ga'i thad du yi dam spyan ras gzigs// mtheb sor tsam zhig 'phur la khad par bsam// khyed rang spyi bor padma zla ba'i steng*// ngo bo bla ma rnam pa 'od dpag med// sku mdog dmar po chos gos rnam gsum gsol// zhabs gnyis byams stabs kyis bzhugs tshangs bug haṃ// bkag pa rgya mthongs phye ba lta bur mdzad// de la bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas// ma lus spyan drangs spyi bo'i bla mar thim// kun 'dus mchog la gsol ba 'di ltar thob// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// 'dren mchog 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol btab lte ba'i rang sems kyi// thig le dbu ma'i lam nas myur du byon// snying ga'i yi dam lha yi thugs kar thim// yi dam nyid kyang tshangs pa'i sgo nas byon// spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs kar sib kyis thim// bla ma yi dam lha dang rang sems gsum// ro gcig 'dres pa'i ngang du mnyam par zhog

/hika zhes pa drag la ring ba brjod/ de lta bu dbugs kyi rgyu ba yongs su ma chad kyi bar du nan tan bya'o// mjug tu padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar sogs dang*/ bzang spyod smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// yang gang zag de nyid nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsgom bzlas la brtson pa'i rigs la ni/ 'dir yang 'chi rim ngo sprod brjod mi brjod skabs dang sbyar la 'di skad brjod de/ gnyis pa 'da' ka 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni// skabs 'dir rlung ni rnam shes thim pa tshun// zhes pa nas/ longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod las 'byung bar bshad// ces pa'i bar sngar ltar gyi rjes su// rgyud sde'i rtse mo rnal 'byor gsar mtha'i bcud// mkha' spyod dga' ma'i zhal lung nya ba'i lam// nā ro ta pa las brgyud sa skya pa'i// gser chos mkhas grub bye bas gshegs pa'i shul// gang gi bsgom bzlas la brten rnal 'byor pas// skye ba 'di la yan lag bdun ldan gnas// mngon du bgyis pa min pas 'da' ka ma'i// myur lam 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor 'di sgoms shig /sdug bsngal 'byung gnas tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la// zhes sogs nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dag par bya ba'i sngon 'gro rnams gong spyan ras gzigs kyi skabs bzhin bya ba'am/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar byas kyang btub bo// dngos gzhi la/ khyed rang yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// snang stong 'ja' lus lta bu'i skur gyur pa'i// lte 'og sor bzhi nas brtsams spyi bo'i bar// dbu ma 'od kyi sbu gu mda' snyug tsam// shel gyi ka ba btsugs ltar yod pa yi// mas sner chos 'byung dmar po chung ngu'i steng*// khyod rang rnam shes ngo bo baṃ yig dmar// ril ma tsam zhig dmar 'od 'phro bar bsam// spyi gtsug dbu ma rgya mthongs ltar phye ba'i// nam mkhar padma zla ba nyi ma dang*// 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su// ngo bo sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma ste// rnam pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sku mdog dmar mo zhal phyag rgyan rdzogs sku// dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su gzigs nas bzhugs// de mthar mkha' spyod dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// sprin ltar 'thibs pas yongs su bskor bar gyur// de dag thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer 'phros// phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// ma lus spyan drangs spyi bo'i bla mar thim// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gyur// de la rang lus longs spyod dge ba rnams// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*// mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs// grangs med sprul pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya// oṃ badzra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

de bzhin du pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpeḥ.āḥhūm̐ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ gsol 'debs ni/ spro na/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs sam/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// zhes sogs nas/ mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i bar brjod/ dus rgyun du ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag /skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar mos gus drag pos gsol btab mthar// hika ces brjod pas lte 'og chos 'byung bsgul// rnam shes ngo bo'i baṃ gyi yi ge de// dbu ma'i lam nas rgya mthongs bya 'phur ltar// tshangs pa'i sgo nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// thugs kar thim ste bla ma yi dam dang*// rang sems ro gcig 'dres pa'i ngang du zhog /khyed la ngas kyang grogs ldan byed pa yin// hika ces kha yar brjod/ de 'dra yang yang byas mthar rnal 'byor ma// dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs par gyur// smon lam ni/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo sogs dang*/ zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam dang*/ bzang spyod smon lam sogs kyang brjod do// yang gang zag de kye rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag thob cing nyams su len pa'i rigs la bya ba ni/ kye ho nas longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod las 'byung bar bshad// ces pa'i bar gong bzhin mang nyung ji ltar 'tsham pa brjod pa'i rjes su/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs kun bgrod gcig lam// mdo rgyud yongs kyi snying po phyung ba'i bcud// 'jigs bral bi rū pa yi bzhed pa'i gzhung*// lam dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i gdams ngag brten// tshe 'dir grub mtha' ma snyogs gang zag 'bring*// bum dbang lam gyi yan lag 'pho ba yis// mkha' spyod rig 'dzin grong du skad cig nyid// bgrod thabs khyod la bstan gyi yid la zungs// tshe 'di'i zhen chags thams cad spangs nas ni// 'chi la 'jigs sems med par btsan thabs su// yang dag lam du 'gro 'dod spro ba ches// myur lam 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor 'di sgoms shig

/sngon 'gro skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs phyogs bcu'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// chos dang 'phags tshogs bstan srung bcas pa la// skyabs su 'gro snyam 'di ltar rjes zlos gyis// spro na/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi// zhes sogs kyis skyabs 'gro dang*/ mar gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir sogs sems bskyed tshigs bcad ma spyi ltar ram mi nus na/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// zhes sogs kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ yan lag bdun pa'i bar sngar bzhin byas mthar/ dngos gzhi'i don du dmigs pa 'di ltar bya/ khyed rang yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje'i sku// snang stong 'ja' lus lta bur gsal btab nas// snying dbus 'od dkar gong bu mthe bong tsam// de las 'od kyi gong bu rim bzhin chad// sems can dmyal ba'i skye sgo bshang lam dgag /de nas dud 'gro'i skye sgo gci pa'i lam// 'dod khams lha yi skye sgo lte ba dgag /yi dwags skye ba'i sgo ni kha'i bug /gnod sbyin skye sgo sna yi bu ga gnyis// mi rje phal pa'i skye sgo mig g.yas g.yon// mi'am ci yi skye sgo rna ba gnyis// gzugs khams lha yi skye sgo mdzod spu dang*// gzugs med lha'i sgo spyi bo'i gtsug rnams dgag /'khor ba'i sgo dgu bkag nas khyed rang gi /spyi bor padma nyi zla bdud bzhi'i steng*// 'khor lo'i mgon po drin chen chos kyi rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma dgyes pa rdo rje'i sku// zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can zhabs bzhi pa// bdag med yum dang rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// gang de'i dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas sems dpa' dang*// bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs bcas ma lus pa// spyan drangs spyi bo'i bla mar dbyer med thim// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid de'i// thugs ka nas ni rang gi lte 'og bar// 'od kyi sbu gus sbrel nas yod par bsam// khyod rang lus kyi nang dbus lte ba'i thad// rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla tshes dbyibs// de steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chung ngu'i steng*// rang sems hūm̐ yig sngon po gsal bar bsgom// lus gnad tsog pu rting pas 'og sgo dgag

/lag gnyis ltag par bsnol te dam du 'khyud// de ltar nus sam ma nus ci bder bya// spyi bo'i bla mar mos gus rtag tu bya// spro na/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang srung mar bcas// skyabs gnas kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma dang*// dbyer med dgyes pa rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i gsol 'debs mos gus tshad med pas// stobs kyi hūm̐ yig drag la reng ba 'don// lus bsgrims 'og sgo 'then cing mig gyen ldog /lce ni rkan sbyar sems kyi dmigs pa ni// lte ba'i rlung gis zla ba hūm̐ yig bcas// bya spu rlung gis bskyod ltar yar yar bteg /hūm̐ sgra nyi shus mgrin pa'i bar drangs nas// nyer gcig pa yis rlung dang zla ba hūm̐// skar mda' 'phos ltar tshangs pa'i lam nas thon// bla ma yi dam dbyer med thugs kar thim// bla ma yi dam rang sems dbyer med par// 'pho bya 'pho byed brjod bral ngang du zhog /zhes brjod hūm̐ ring nyer gcig bar du brjod// de 'dra ma 'phos bar du yang yang bya// mjug tu dge ba bsngo ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing sogs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas sogs dang*/ skye ba kun du yang dag bla ma sogs bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod do// de nas bar dor 'phyan pa rnams la ngo sprod gdams pa ni/ gsum pa bar do'i chos gtam bya ba ni/ kye ho 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu// tshe dus las 'das che ge mo zhes pa// bdag la tshur gson rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin zhes pa nas/ gang rung gdams pa khyod la bshad kyis nyon// ci ste 'pho ba'i dus kyis bskal sogs la// 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor gnad du ma song na// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku shar ba na// sngar 'dris mdza' bo phrad ltar shes pas ni// blo 'das ngang du bskyangs pas don 'grub mod// de las langs nas lus sems so sor 'bral// gal te bar do'i 'khrul snang shar gyur na// de la bar do'i ngo sprod 'di ltar zung*// srid pa bar dor brdzus te skyes pa yi// rnam par gzhag pa 'chi srid skye srid kyi// bar du 'byung bas bar srid ces bya ste// yid lus yin phyir rang dang rigs mthun dang*// lha mig dag las gzhan gyis mthong bya min// phyi rol nyi zla'i snang ba mi 'byung ste// nang du dkar dmar khams kyis dben phyir ro// gang du skye 'gyur bar do'i sha tshugs te// rigs drug 'gro ba gang du skye 'gyur gyi// sha tshugs dang ni byad gzugs 'dzin par grub// 'dul lung phran tshegs sogs las ji skad du// dmyal ba'i bar do sdong dum mes tshig bzhin// yi dwags chu dang dud 'gro'i du ba dang*// mi yi gser dang lha yi bar do ni// snam bu dkar po lta bu'i snang ba 'char// 'od lam ltar na nag lam dmyal ba dang*// ser po yi dwags dkar po dud 'gro dang*// dmar po lha dang ljang gu lha ma yin// sna tshogs gsal na mi ru skye 'gyur bshad// kun las btus par skye ba'i gnas su thogs// de las gzhan pa'i ri dang rtsig pa sogs// thogs rdugs med par chu la nya bzhin du// bgrod pa las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// gdos bcas lus bral grib ma rjes mi 'byung*// mig dang rna ba sna lce lus dbang ste// dbang po kun tshang yul la nye ring bral// zag bcas shes pas gzhan sems phyogs re mthong*// bza' ba dri la rnam par zhen pas na// dri yi zas dang skye srid 'tshol ba'i phyir// phyogs kun rgyu bas 'byung bzhi'i rlung 'khrugs te// sa rlung 'khrugs pas ri bo grum pa'i sgra// chu rlung 'khrugs pas rgya mtsho 'chol ba'i sgra// me rlung 'khrugs pas dus mtha'i me 'bar sgra// rlung gi rlung 'khrugs bskal pa 'jig dus kyi// rlung gi sgrar mtshungs 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi dang*// dug gsum rang gzugs nyam nga'i g.yang sa gsum// mthong ba'i rkyen gyis 'jigs skrag byung ba'i tshe// bar do'i 'khrul snang yin par shes gyis la// gang yang bden par zhen pa'i dngangs skrag bskyungs// bar do'i tshe tshad ring thung nges med kyang*// phal cher zhag bdun de nas 'chi 'pho ste// der yang skye ba'i tshogs pa ma rnyed na// slar yang zhag bdun de 'dra bdun bdun bar// skye 'chi spel mar bar dor gnas pa'i mthar// rigs drug gang yin skye ba sa sder bshad// de ltar bshad pa'i rnam grangs de dag gis// khyod kyang bar dor gnas par shes nas ni// 'khrul snang bden par ma zhen bag yod byos// bla ma dkon mchog blo gtad skyabs 'gro bya// sdug bsngal 'byung gnas 'dod chags zhe sdang dang*// gti mug gis bslangs mi dge sdig pa'i las// sngar byas 'gyod sems drag pos bshags shing bsdam// de las ldog pa'i dge bcur spyod snyam bya// gnas lugs don ni laṅkar gshegs pa las// bag chags kyis ni rnam par dkrugs pa'i sems// phyi rol don du snang ba rab tu 'byung*// don yod ma yin rang gi sems nyid de// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin gsungs phyir// snod bcud bde sdug snang ba ji snyed kyang*// sems nyid las dang nyon mongs bag chags kyis// bslad pa'i snang ba rmi lam yul snang ltar// snang mkhan sems nyid de dang der snang tsam// sems kyang brtag na lus kyi phyi nang dang*// gnyis ka'i bar na med cing mi dmigs so// zhes gsungs phyir na sems la kha dog dbyibs// gcig dang du ma med phyir ngo bos stong*// ngo bo med pa gang de gdod ma nas// ma skyes phyir na dang por skye ba med// skye med de la sdod pa med pa'i phyir// bar du rang gi ngo bos gnas pa med// mi gnas pa la 'jig pa ma grub phyir// tha mar 'gags med rang bzhin stong pa nyid// blo 'das brjod bral ngang du mnyam par zhog
/de las 'khrul snang rtog pa 'phro gyur na// dbang

dbang bskur thob pa'i gang zag yin na/ bskur thob pa'i slob dpon sku rdo rje// de yis bstan pa'i rang lus yi dam lha// rdo rje'i gsang mtshan gsum po dran pa gces// sngar nas goms pa'i bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor dang*// rang gzhan cir snang snang stong lha yi sku// sgra rnams grag stong gnyis med sngags kyi sgra// dran bsam rig stong dbyer med lha yi thugs// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mnyam par zhog /bar do'i shes pa sngar las ches gsal zhing*// dran myur ye shes bsgom pa stobs che phyir// bar dor longs skur 'tshang rgya bgyid dus so// des na chos kun skye med sems nyid snang*// snang tsam gshis lugs yod med mtshan rtog bral// bral yang rang gdangs ma 'gags bde ba'i sku// sku dang ye shes lhun grub ngang du skyongs// gang phyir srid pa bar do'i sems can gyi// 'khrul snang zhen pa'i 'ching zhags gcod byed pa'i// legs par bshad pa'i ral gri 'di chongs dang*// thar pa'i lam du rnam par grol bar 'gyur// zhes brjod do// smras pa/ lus can skye 'chi bar do'i 'jigs skrag mi bzad las// bsgral 'dod brtse dang byang chub sems ldan chos smra bas// dgos don snying po'i gdams pa rgyud la nges byas nas// skabs su gang babs yang dag legs bshad mkhas pa'i lugs// bde legs go sar ngal gsor 'god pa'i don mthun bdag 'da' ka'i dus babs chos gtam gru 'di ma bzung bar// bde ldan bsti gnas nor bu'i gling du 'khrid 'dod kyang*// 'khrul snang rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu yang nam zhig phyin// gang phyir 'di sbyar dge ba'i ma zlum dkyil 'khor gyis// skye 'gro ma lus 'chi kha bar do'i 'khrul snang gi /thun gsum las bsgral yang dag gzigs pa'i lam chen nas// thar pa dam pa'i grong khyer 'khrid pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces 'chi kha bar do'i 'gro ba rnams la gdams pa chos gtam thar par 'khrid pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/

hor brag 'go'i bla ma sprul pa'i sku mkhas btsun blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis 'di ltar byas pa dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor theg pa che chung gi gzhung dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dang*/ gser chos kyi mkha' spyod dang*/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bur bcas pa'i gdams ngag la sogs pa'i bzhed pa dang rjes su mthun par/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi bsti gnas su bris pa la/ slar yang kha 'gengs zhu nan dang bcas pa bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //na mo ratna tra yā ya/ mtshan tsam 'dzin pas mngon mtho nges legs dpal// ci yang sbyin pa'i thugs rje'i phyag brkyang ba// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras slob srung mar bcas// smon lam gang btab 'grub pa'i bden dpang blta// bdag ni skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs phreng*// dal 'byor rten ldan dge ba'i bshes dang phrad// mchog gsum skyabs kyi grib bsil ngal gso zhing*// de yi bslab byar slob la spro bar shog /rgyal bstan snying po sdom pa'i nor bu gsum// bag med nyes ltung 'dam du mi bskyur bar// bslab sbyang brtson pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser 'god cing*// bstan 'gror phan bde'i 'dod dgu 'jo bar shog /phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung lugs thos bsams dang*// bsgoms byung lung rtogs yon tan ches cher rgyas// rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i mthar son nas// phyi mar dag pa'i zhing mchog skye bar shog /gnas skabs kun du dbul phongs mi mthun phyogs// nad dang dus min 'chi ba dgra 'dre yi// 'jigs pa de dag mi 'byung byung ba yang*// nyer zhi bde dga' dpal 'byor rtsen par shog /ces rgyun 'khyer gyi smon lam bsam don 'grub pa'i rkang mgyogs zhes bya ba 'di ni/
